item.title: dotnet: A faster, lighter C# Dev Kit
item.description:

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: HydraFusion in VS Code and the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
HydraFusion research preview is now available in Visual Studio Code and the GitHub Copilot app, expanding access beyond Copilot CLI. It appears in the model picker in both products.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Formatter
item.description:
SQL Formatter is now generally available for Visual Studio Code, allowing SQL scripts to be formatted directly in the editor. It includes customizable formatting options to match preferred code styles.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 7
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s Sept. 7 weekly release adds Jira integration in Copilot app and adaptive model orchestration via Project HydraFusion in Copilot CLI. It also introduces new agent automation in Visual Studio Code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added customizable keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor in Visual Studio Code. The changes can be configured directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, July 2026 releases
item.description:
GitHub’s July 2026 Copilot-in-VS Code changelog covers VS Code v1.127 through v1.131. The releases focus on agent workflows, reviewing changes, chat, and navigation improvements.

  • Source: GitHub
